theorem QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.OS_heckeAction_injective {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (q qi : R) (h : q * qi = 1) {m : ℕ} (hm : m + 1 ≤ n) :
Function.Injective ⇑((OS.OSCat.cross q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)).heckeAction m)

theorem QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.lift_heckeAction {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (q qi : R) (h : q * qi = 1) (m : ℕ) :
(mapEndAlg R (glnFunctor q qi h) (tpow (OS.OSCat.E q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)) (m + 1))).comp ((OS.OSCat.cross q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)).heckeAction m) = (conjAlg R (Φ q qi h (m + 1))).comp ((crossing q qi h).heckeAction m)

theorem QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.conjAlg_injective {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {𝒟 : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} 𝒟] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive 𝒟] [CategoryTheory.Linear R 𝒟] {A B : 𝒟} (e : A ≅ B) :

def QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.conjAlg (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {𝒟 : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} 𝒟] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive 𝒟] [CategoryTheory.Linear R 𝒟] {A B : 𝒟} (e : A ≅ B) :

theorem QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.map_gen {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (q qi : R) (h : q * qi = 1) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin k) :
(glnFunctor q qi h).map ((OS.OSCat.cross q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)).gen k i) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Φ q qi h (k + 1)).hom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((crossing q qi h).gen k i) (Φ q qi h (k + 1)).inv)

theorem QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.map_gen_zero {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (q qi : R) (h : q * qi = 1) (k : ℕ) :
(glnFunctor q qi h).map (leftCross (OS.OSCat.cross q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)).S (tpow (OS.OSCat.E q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)) k)) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Φ q qi h (k + 2)).hom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (leftCross (S q qi) (tpow (X R n) k)) (Φ q qi h (k + 2)).inv)

theorem QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.map_gen_succ {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (q qi : R) (h : q * qi = 1) (k : ℕ) (j : Fin k) (g : tpow (OS.OSCat.E q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)) (k + 1) ⟶ tpow (OS.OSCat.E q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)) (k + 1)) (ih : (glnFunctor q qi h).map g = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Φ q qi h (k + 1)).hom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((crossing q qi h).gen k j) (Φ q qi h (k + 1)).inv)) :
(glnFunctor q qi h).map (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (OS.OSCat.E q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)) g) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (Φ q qi h (k + 2)).hom (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (X R n) ((crossing q qi h).gen k j)) (Φ q qi h (k + 2)).inv)

theorem QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.Φ_succ_inv {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (q qi : R) (h : q * qi = 1) (k : ℕ) :
(Φ q qi h (k + 1)).inv = CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (X R n) (Φ q qi h k).inv

theorem QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.Φ_succ_hom {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (q qi : R) (h : q * qi = 1) (k : ℕ) :
(Φ q qi h (k + 1)).hom = CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (X R n) (Φ q qi h k).hom

noncomputable def QOU.OrientedSkein.GLn.Φ {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n : ℕ} (q qi : R) (h : q * qi = 1) (k : ℕ) :
(glnFunctor q qi h).obj (tpow (OS.OSCat.E q qi (q ^ n) (∑ i : Fin n, wt n q qi i)) k) ≅ tpow (X R n) k
